title: Avocado & Poached Egg Toast
description: Creamy smashed avocado on sourdough, topped with perfectly poached eggs and red pepper flakes.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp.
In a bowl, mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Bring a small pot of water with a dash of vinegar to a simmer. Create a vortex and gently drop in eggs. Poach for 3 minutes.
Spread smashed avocado evenly over toasts.
Top with poached eggs, sprinkle chili flakes and fresh ground pepper.

title: Berry Fluffy Pancake Stack
description: Golden fluffy pancakes layered with fresh berries, whipped cream, and pure maple syrup.
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix milk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed; let batter rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a buttered griddle over medium heat. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, flip and cook until golden brown.
Serve warm stacked with fresh berries and maple syrup.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: Nutrient-packed bowl with fluffy quinoa, chickpeas, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and tahini dressing.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and roasted
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let cool slightly.
Toss chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, salt, and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 20 mins.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, warm water, salt, and garlic to make dressing.
Divide quinoa into bowls. Arrange chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta on top.
Drizzle generously with tahini dressing and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad Wrap
description: Juicy grilled chicken strips wrapped with crisp Romaine lettuce, Parmesan, and Caesar dressing in a tortilla.
instructions: Season chicken breast with garlic powder, salt, and pepper; grill for 6 minutes per side until cooked through.
In a bowl, toss lettuce, Parmesan, croutons, and Caesar dressing.
Warm tortillas in a skillet for 10 seconds per side.
Lay chicken slices across the center of each tortilla and top with salad mixture.
Tightly fold in the sides and roll up. Cut diagonally and serve.

title: Creamy Garlic Butter Tuscan Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets bathed in a rich garlic, sun-dried tomato, and spinach cream sauce.
instructions: Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 mins per side; set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat, pour in heavy cream, and bring to a gentle simmer while stirring.
Stir in spinach and Parmesan cheese until spinach is wilted and sauce thickens.
Return salmon to skillet, spoon sauce over top, and garnish with basil.

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Crispy homemade pizza crust topped with rich San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and aromatic basil leaves.
instructions: Preheat oven with pizza stone at 500°F (260°C) for 45 minutes.
Stretch dough on parchment paper into a 12-inch round.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a 1-inch border.
Arrange fresh mozzarella pieces over sauce.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is charred and cheese is bubbly.
Top with fresh basil, a drizzle of olive oil, and sea salt before slicing.

title: Velvety Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Decadent individual chocolate cakes with a warm, flowing molten chocolate center.
ingredients: Powdered sugar & vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Butter and dust 4 ramekins with cocoa powder.
Melt butter and chopped dark chocolate together in a heatproof bowl set over simmering water.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and vanilla until light and thick.
Fold melted chocolate mixture and flour gently into egg mixture.
Divide batter into ramekins and bake for 12 minutes until sides are firm but center jiggles.
Let cool 1 minute, invert onto dessert plates, dust with powdered sugar and serve with ice cream.

title: Fresh Strawberry Shortcake Parfait
description: Layers of tender buttery biscuit cubes, vanilla bean whipped cream, and macerated fresh strawberries.
ingredients: 2 shortcake biscuits or pound cake, cubed
instructions: Toss sliced strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar in a bowl; let macerate for 20 minutes.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla bean paste until soft peaks form.
In glass dessert cups, layer cake cubes, macerated strawberries with juice, and whipped cream.
Repeat layers once more.
Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving garnished with a mint sprig.

title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Edamame
description: Blanched edamame pods tossed in olive oil, minced garlic, grated Parmesan, and sea salt.
ingredients: 1 lb frozen edamame pods in shell
instructions: Boil edamame pods in salted water for 4 minutes; drain and pat thoroughly dry.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add dry edamame pods and toss continuously for 3 minutes until slightly charred.
Transfer to a platter, toss with Parmesan cheese, and sprinkle flaky sea salt.

title: Loaded Homemade Guacamole with Chips
description: Chunky authentic guacamole made with ripe Haas avocados, lime, cilantro, jalapeño, and diced tomatoes.
instructions: Cut avocados in half, remove pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash coarsely with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Stir in lime juice and salt immediately.
Fold in red onion, jalapeno pepper, tomatoes, and chopped cilantro.
Taste and adjust salt or lime as needed. Serve immediately with warm tortilla chips.

title: Thai Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: Fragrant and creamy yellow coconut curry packed with chickpeas, sweet potato, spinach, and Thai spices.
ingredients: 2 tbsp Thai red or yellow curry paste
1 large sweet potato, peeled and cubed
Jasmine rice & fresh lime for serving
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pot; add onion, garlic, and ginger; sauté 4 minutes.
Stir in curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cubed sweet potato, chickpeas, and coconut milk. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Squeeze fresh lime juice.
Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice.

title: Rainbow Tofu Veggie Stir-Fry
description: Crispy pan-fried tofu cubes tossed with colorful snap peas, bell peppers, broccoli, and sesame ginger glaze.
ingredients: 1 block (14 oz) extra firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Toss tofu cubes in cornstarch until lightly coated.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Fry tofu for 8 mins until golden and crispy on all sides; remove.
In the same wok, stir-fry broccoli, bell pepper, and snap peas for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk soy sauce, maple syrup, sesame oil, and ginger in a cup.
Return tofu to wok, pour sauce over, and toss for 2 minutes until glossy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Classic Italian arborio rice slow-cooked with sautéed wild cremini mushrooms, white wine, and Parmesan.
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat until browned; set aside.
In a deep pan, melt remaining butter and sauté shallot and garlic for 2 mins.
Add Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes until translucent around edges.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed.
Add warm broth 1 ladle at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding next ladle (about 18-20 mins).
Stir in mushrooms, Parmesan cheese, and fresh thyme. Serve rich and creamy.

title: Vegan Mango Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick tropical smoothie bowl blended with frozen mango, banana, and coconut milk, topped with chia and kiwi.
ingredients: Toppings: sliced kiwi, toasted coconut flakes, raspberries, pumpkin seeds
instructions: Combine frozen mango, frozen banana, and coconut milk in a high-speed blender.
Blend on high, using a tamper tool to push ingredients down, until thick and smooth like soft-serve.
Scoop thick smoothie into chilled bowls.
Arrange kiwi slices, coconut flakes, raspberries, pumpkin seeds, and chia seeds artfully on top.

title: Classic Beef Smash Burgers
description: Double crispy-edged beef patties pressed thin on a scorching skillet, layered with melted American cheese and special sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb 80/20 ground beef, shaped into 4 balls
4 tbsp special burger sauce (mayo, ketchup, relish, mustard)
instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle until smoking hot.
Place 2 beef balls onto skillet and smash flat with a sturdy spatula using parchment paper.
Season generously with salt and pepper. Sear for 2 minutes until edges are crispy and lacy.
Flip patties, immediately top each with a slice of cheese, and cook 1 minute more.
Spread special sauce on toasted brioche buns, stack double patties with pickles, and press bun top down.

title: Crispy Zucchini Fries with Aioli
description: Oven-baked crunchy zucchini spears coated in seasoned panko breadcrumbs, served with lemon garlic aioli.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine panko, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
Dip zucchini spears into beaten eggs, then press into breadcrumb mixture to coat.
Arrange in a single layer on baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.
Whisk mayo, lemon juice, and minced garlic for aioli dipping sauce. Serve hot!
